description: This file contains Perl code for generating optimized assembly implementations of GHASH functions for x86_64, including AVX and CLMUL versions, used in cryptographic operations within OpenSSL and BoringSSL. It includes routines for initialization, multiplication, and GHASH processing with hardware acceleration.
